% Pattern: number/class-section. ieeeconf prints \thesection as
% \Roman{section}, but its \newtheorem{thm}{..}[section] prints
% \arabic{section}, so the theorem of section II is 2.1. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass[conference]{ieeeconf}
\newtheorem{Thm}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{Thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\section{Two}
\begin{Thm} Every finite space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\end{document}
